Spooky Afternoon, Spooksters of Ignus! We’re finally ready to unleash the horrors of Halloween into the world with our very special Halloween Event! Starting right now and ending November 1st, you can enjoy the joy of trick-or-treating here in Citadel!

How To Trick-or-Treat
Step One: Find a World Chest
Every good trick-or-treater has a plan of attack! Know your destinations; Halloween treats can be found in any of the treasure chests that populate the enemy camps, caves and other various noteworthy locales in Ignus. 

Step Two: Clear The Enemies
Show the chest’s guardians the true meaning of Halloween fear! Clear out the camp or cave and the treasure will be yours to plunder. Be sure to come prepared for a fight. The higher tier the chest, the stronger the enemies that surround it will be.

Step Three: Loot Your Treats!
It’s treat time! Cross your fingers and crack open the chest! Each type of reward comes in multiple varieties with differing drop rates. Keep trick or treating to collect them all before the event ends!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d941f8c81a47b35e2b932941800aba06e51c9c4b.png

If you’d like to learn more about the types of new content you can get through Trick or Treating, check out our preview post from earlier! 

Crafting Persists on Server Restart
Your prayers have been answered! Now you can safely load up your various crafting structures with resources and not have to worry about losing your resources if the server happens to go down when you are away. Want to build an enormous Marble structure? Load your Forges up with Stone, go to sleep, and safely return the next day to a beautiful stack of Slabs, ready for you to start creating your masterpiece!

Third Person Improvements
We’ve made major improvements to the experience of playing the game in third person! We’ve added a slew of new, much more natural animations to make your character look less awkward. Gone are the days of stiff running!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c5a1ec83caa5e17dbd84eeed77de9b5175504fc7.gif

Additionally, the camera has been greatly improved in third person. Your character will now face toward the reticule, opting to strafe or back pedal rather than always running in the direction you push. Even better, when your character is standing still, you are now able to freely rotate the camera! This will make taking glamour shots of your mage so much easier!

Much More!
Check out the patch notes below for the full details of what’s new with today’s update! We’re delighted to share the new update with you, and can’t wait to hear how you’re enjoying the new content. As always, we’ll be listening for your feedback, so please feel free to share on the forums. Make sure you give the servers a moment to come back up with the newest version of the game, and we hope to see you in the new SPOOOOOOKY Ignus!

Time-Limited Content
New Content: Three Spooky Ghost costume variants available in chests
New Content: Two spooky Pumpkin head costume variants available in chests
New Content: Two Monster Mask costume variants available in chests
New Content: Four Halloween candies and chocolates available in chests
Ignus has been made spOoOoOkier (red moon, spooky props, scary town names)

Structures
New Content: Trapdoor structure piece
New Content: Two types of Spike Traps structure pieces
New Content: Acid Pool structure piece
New Content: Three Tombstone building props
Crafting benches now properly save materials and continue working after server restarts
Graphical improvements to structure piece preview

Other
 Significant improvements to third person animation and camera behaviour
New tutorial stone UI pop ups
Fixed map screen related crashes
Respawn button now available in pause menu

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e68d2a15a90a4404f958f5c7c69ea64fe2e47a5f.gif

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/11/2017 - Reduced Marble/Ornate Costs, Various Fixes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0faf2770b4cebe6169d02bde85dbd3c35e2e9943.jpg

Good afternoon, Wizards! Another Wednesday has arrived, which means it’s once again time for us to patch Citadel with some wonderful new fixes and balance changes. 

As you may remember from last week’s patch notes, we will be settling into a new patch cycle. Patches will still be released every Wednesday, but each week will alternate between minor patches and major patches. By making this change we will have more time to prepare and test new content, while at the same time having consistent stretches of time where we can evaluate and fix bugs within existing content. Today is our first minor patch, which means we are focused on evaluating changes made from last patch and applying some stability fixes.

Reduced Marble/Ornate Costs
We heard your feedback from last week’s patch loud and clear. While our goal with raising the building cost of Marble and Ornate was to increase the perceived value of the high-tier structures and slow the appearance of massive, server straining mega-structures, we realize now that we may have gone a bit overboard in our approach.

To improve this balance change, we’re making a few significant concessions. Firstly, Precious Stone has been completely removed from the recipes for Marble and Ornate Slabs. These resources were distributed quite sparingly into Ignus to give them a certain rarity, and to have them be a major component of building created for an unnecessarily tedious situation. Our second concession is to reduce the amount of slabs needed overall. Slab costs for walls and floors have been reduced an additional 15-20%.

Siege Spell Damage/Structure Health Rebalance
This is a minor fix to make Siege Spell Damage and Structure Health easier to manage. Both have been reduced by about 15-20%. What does this mean? Functionally, almost nothing. They've been readjusted in equal measures to make the numbers more manageable, but the number of spells it'll take to take out a wall has not changed. This is a visual/user-friendliness fix.

More Fixes/Tweaks
Additionally, we’ve also fixed some nasty bugs to better improve the general gameplay experience. Structures have been optimized to cause less strain on both the client and server, crashes have been fixed for some players on server joins and when opening the tame menu, and we’ve fixed up a visual glitch with the top of some Marble walls clipping through floors above them. Take a look here for the complete notes:

Curved Marble walls now properly do not clip through floors above them
Optimized structure code to reduce server and client stress
Reduced Slab costs for Marble and Ornate structures by 15-20% per piece
Removed Precious Stone from Marble and Ornate Slab recipes
Crashes fixed on joining server
Crashes fixed on opening the tamed creature menu
Siege Spells damage decreased
Structure Health decreased

Coming Soon
As discussed above, next week’s patch will be a major patch. We’re preparing some fun goodies to introduce our first time-limited in-game event in celebration of the Halloween season, so stay tuned for some exciting details later this week! Thanks again for your support and feedback as we continue to work through Early Access, and we hope to see you in Ignus soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/4/2017 - New Castle Props & Flight Speed Increase
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/289d29bd48b28a2ba59de499b7f1cd474e14a2ff.jpg

It’s Wednesday, which means we have another patch ready to go! In addition to bug fixes and balance improvements, today’s patch will introduce another selection of lovely castle props for you to inject some decorative flair into your drab castles. From tables and chairs to beds and barrels, we’ve got just what you need to turn your hovel into a home! Take a look at yesterday’s patch preview for full details on this wonderful new prop pack.

As we also mentioned yesterday, we’ve added a bit more to the way tame times are calculated while using Pacify. Tame times will be calculated based on a number of factors including the level of the player’s weapon, the level of the creature, debuffs that may be applied to the creature, and the creature’s current HP. We hope to give players a greater feeling of control and to make the pacification process a more engaging experience.

We’ve added a few new reagents to the game to add a little more complexity to the building system and add an extra sense of value to the higher-tier structure options. To compensate for this new step in high-level crafting, we’re decreasing the weight burden presented by raw reagents. This should make it easier for everyone to do large resource harvests without frequently having to return home and unload.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/4489ba1e52e8acc1623e206e79408b840058532e.jpg

We’ve also done another revision to the changes we made to the speed of brooms and flight potions following your feedback since our last patch. Our goal with these tweaks was to reduce the speed of these traversal options to encourage players to use the other means of their travel and experience more of the game’s world. On paper, these adjustments made sense, but a bug in our code caused an issue where all the items moved at a very similar speed. We’ve now fixed this bug, and the higher tier flight trinkets should be significantly faster. On top of that, the amount of mana they burn should also now be much less aggressive.

Take a look below for the full list of changes, and be sure to give servers a chance to update and come back up. We hope you enjoy today’s patch, and look forward to seeing you in Ignus!

New Items
New Building Props: Tables
New Building Props: Chairs
New Building Prop: Bed
New Building Props: Barrels
New Reagent: Blue Gold Ingot
New Reagent: Ornate Marble Slab
New Reagent: White Marble Slab
New Reagent: Flawless Rune Gem
New Reagent: Enchanted Stone

Other Changes
Flight trinket speeds and mana burn rates have been fixed
Raw reagents have had their weight values reduced
Tame times now scale based on enemy HP, weapon level and much more
Fixed an error that caused the cursor to disappear on character creation
Various crash fixes

Future Patch Schedule
Following this patch, we will be slightly altering our approach to updates to increase our efficiency and improve our ability to deliver a better gameplay experience. Patches will still be released every Wednesday, but each week will alternate between minor patches and major patches.

Our goal in minor patch weeks will be to fix crashes, improve stability and fine-tune recently added content. During major patch weeks, we will focus on adding new content, upgrading gameplay systems, and rebalancing the gameplay experience. By making this change we will have more time to prepare and test new content, while at the same time having consistent stretches of time where we can evaluate and fix bugs within existing content.

We thank you for your support as we’ve worked through Early Access, and hope this change will help us deliver you the best possible Citadel experience!

notes.title: Patch Preview - New Castle Props, New Reagents & Pacify Changes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18a149ecd973151d449149e257e93e482cb5eb54.jpg

Hello all! Tomorrow we'll be satisfying another community request by adding another set of castle props for players to fill their amazing dwellings with! Before this update, many players gave the feedback that their homes felt a little empty. We're adding a selection of basic furniture props to the game to finally breath some life into your empty dining halls and cavernous lounges!

New Building Props

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1b5f5a5fa2bfc7265ae6472385e4d29320f58388.jpg
Tables
A table is much more than a flat, elevated surface supported by four legs! Tables are a social hub! They are where people come together, where ideas are shared, and where allies are made. Grab a potion, gather ‘round your housemates, and raise your flask to friends old and new!

Or you know, maybe they are just flat, elevated surfaces supported by four legs. Either way, we have them now, and they’ll look fantastic in your castles!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c467313fda6fa8dcf19e52db428913ef80597f36.jpg
Chairs
You can’t have tables without chairs, which is why we’ve prepare two lovely seating options for your wizardly posterior! Kick up the ol’ dogs on one of two fantastic choices: On the left we have a simple wooden dining chair, and on the right we have a lovely leather padded lounger.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/8562cd16bde39911a5a575fcea48271927eed21f.jpg
Bed
Slaying the undead and taming massive dragons can be exhausting; why not build yourself a cozy, quiet space to kick back and unwind? With the upcoming addition of beds, you can finally turn your hovel into a home!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/aa0894b0fb2e455f3cdc8de27bda966d80f942ff.jpg
Barrels
We’ve also thrown in a couple barrels as additional options to give your space a little more flavor. Expect more simple props in the future to improve the aesthetic of your space!


Taming Re-balance

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/948dc741d535ac10753919501e40d99c6548f151.jpg
We'll also be applying a re-balance to taming in this upcoming patch. Historically, Pacify times were calculated in a linear fashion: The higher the creature’s level, the longer it would take to Pacify them. With our next update we’ll be adding a little more variability to the experience. 

Tame times will be calculated based on a number of factors including the level of the player’s weapon, the level of the creature, debuffs that may be applied to the creature, and the creature’s current HP. That Infernal Dragon taking too long to tame? Bring down its health, stun it with Gaslight, and pull out your strongest weapon! We hope that these new variables will make the taming of creatures a much less tedious and much more engaging experience.


New Reagents

We'll also be adding a few new reagents to the game:
Blue Gold Ingot: 2 Gold Ore + 2 Iron Ore
Ornate Marble Slab: 2 Stone + 1 Precious Stone
White Marble Slab: 2 Stone + 1 Precious Stone
Flawless Rune Gem: 3 Rune Cystal
Enchanted Stone: 5 Stone + 5 Rune Crystal + 1 Precious Stone

These reagents will be added to the recipes for a number of building items, including magic structures, marble structural pieces and ornate structural pieces. As you can see, Precious Stone is about to get a lot more valuable, so the time to start stocking up is now!

Much More!

We'll have more info to share with you all tomorrow, including bug fixes and gameplay tweaks.Stay tuned for the full patch notes, and we'll see you in Ignus with some brand new content soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/2/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/df7f926eac4d67c53036d30848789497902cebc5.jpg

Good afternoon, Wizards of Ignus! We’re putting out another quick patch today to fix a bug that caused lower than normal health for some tames, and to address some feedback we received over the weekend regarding a few changes that were made in last week’s patch.

As many of you noticed, last week’s patch resulted in a decrease in speed for our various flying trinkets. Both brooms and potions saw their maximum speeds greatly reduced, severely diminishing the value in upgrading your tools beyond the lowest level flight options. We’ve heard your feedback, and have boosted their flight speeds up closer to what they once were. 

Additionally, we’ve also boosted the basic walking speed back to its original value. While we were hoping to improve the distinction between walking and running, we decided to revert this change after hearing your resounding feedback.

Below are the complete details for today’s patch. Be sure to update your game via Steam and give the servers time to come back up with the latest version of the game. See you in Ignus!

Patch Notes
Flight speeds increased
Walking speeds increased
Fix for low tamed and wild creature HP values

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/28/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/51aec950a62da2f872a0b17c0948aa291d82a949.gif

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We’re finally ready to redeploy yesterday’s patch! As mentioned yesterday, this update once again is focused on refining the current Citadel experience to prepare for future content implementations.

With yesterday's patch, many NPCs became tremendously overpowered. Some players even reported encountering Infernal Dragons with as much as 600,000 HP! This was clearly not intentional, and we've fixed the issue that caused this hiccup.

We’re working to have some new stuff ready to go in next week’s patch, but for today we’ll be sharing some visual improvements along with an assortment of crash fixes. 

Reformation Stone Redesign
The Reformation Stone has been updated! Previously, it was hard to discern what your Reformation Stones were doing and when they were doing it. We’ve created a whole new set of VFX to pretty up the Reformation Stone and show specifically which pieces it’s healing. It looks pretty flashy!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/007a8516bdd698e01f3ec7919e72f773668d3f1f.gif

UI Improvements
We’ve also injected another dose of UI love with this update, adding some nice new region title cards and a revamp of the loot window. These are the latest updates in or on-going beautification of the game’s UI, bringing these two parts of the interface up to the standard of the other recently updated interfaces. Expect more in the future!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1a9c1095e0ea278d4f1147ca65b5647db09d83f7.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/0d113987a5a16de206551415a7b219b62b67be8c.gif

Walk Animation Improvements
The fast paced life of a Wizard can be overwhelming. Take a moment to smell the roses with our new walking animation! Previously, we used the same animation for both running and walking, which a number of players reported as a bit disorienting. Now, when you’re not holding the run button, your character will do a distinct walking animation.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/20/2017 - Bug Fixes & Game Improvements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/972a67a79f02009b87f6584c1d8b131a0e05cba2.jpg

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We once again find ourselves meeting here on a Wednesday, which can only mean that it’s time for our weekly patch! As you may have heard earlier this week in our livestream, today’s patch will not be bringing any new content into Ignus. Rather, we’ve decided to focus down on bug fixing, tidying up a bunch of the community’s most frequently reported issues.

Firstly, we've made some major improvements to performance on servers with large populations and complicated structures. We'll be continuing to look into issues related to server performance degradation, but with today's patch you should hopefully notice a bump in stability.

Next up, Flight Potions will now no longer fill your vision with thick black smoke! These potions were always designed for slow, deliberate flight for precision activities such as building and navigating tight areas. To improve their functionality for these purposes, we’ve taken your feedback to heart and reduced the amount of heavy smoke that these potions emit while in-use.

We’ve also prepared a fix for Necrosis! Many members of the community have lamented the spell’s extreme damage output, requesting a re-evaluation of its balance. Upon investigation, we discovered a programmatic issue with how the spell’s damage was being handled by the game, and have resolved the issue. Necrosis should now no longer the only PVP-viable spell in your arsenal.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c28357f81150724ea6773c93411277b75bfbb447.jpg

Many players have found frustration with the Deconstructor, so we gave it a little love this week in two areas. Firstly, we've made it so the Deconstructor no longer dumps bags all over the place, and instead behaves more like the other magic structures. Secondly, we've fixed a bug that caused the Deconstructor to not work properly with stacked items. Now it will give you the full amount of resources for a stack of items, rather than behaving as if you only fed it one item.

One last major improvement we’d like to highlight here is our fix for tames disappearing on server restarts. We’ve been wrestling with this issue for a while, but we’ve finally prepared a solution that should eliminate this problem for good. No longer will you return after an update to find your precious mounts have evaporated without a trace!

There are so many fixes in this update that I’d like to highlight here – from major crash fixes and performance bumps, to magic structure upgrades and general quality of life improvements – but I think it’s best to let the patch notes speak for themselves. Take a look below at the list, and please feel free to share your feedback and thoughts on our forums! We will continue to digest everything you send us, and will use it to continue improving Citadel as we move forward on our Early Access journey!

Structures
Deconstructor no longer dumps bags everywhere
Deconstructor works properly with stacked items
Empty Magic Structures will now properly replenish mana when hooked up to a generator
Can now hold ‘E’ to completely fill a Mana Generator with Rune Crystal instead of having to tap multiple times

Spells
Necrosis’ extremely high damage has been reduced
Heal Beam’s power has been significantly increased
Fixed instances where Pacify could be stopped for seemingly no reason

Creatures
Tamed creatures will now no longer disappear on server restart
Fixed an issue that caused mana drain to continue when transitioning from broom to mount

User Interface
Fixed an issue causing players on Private/Custom servers to lose unlocked build menu options (This will prevent the issue from happening again, but won't fix users who are already affected. You can fix this by using admin commands to spawn in an Elixir of Amnesia and using it.)

Other
Unequipping a Broomstick or Flight Potion now stops flight
Keybindings now properly persist between game sessions
Flight Potions no longer fill your vision with thick black smoke in first-person
Various crash fixes
Fixed issues where some players could not load into a server
Server performance improvements
Graphic performance improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/13/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/975a32f9ace05692ad1d501b5ba0b277ddd7a0bc.jpg

It’s Wednesday, which means we’re ready to drop another new Citadel update! Today’s patch includes some fantastic new content including a horrific new enemy and a gorgeous new high-level melee weapon. 

The Blade of Simeon's Soul is a powerful magic blade capable of delivering devastating damage to enemies, human or otherwise. Paired with buff spells like Bloodlust, this level 50 sword is capable of pushing extreme damage in a short period of time, though you will be forced to deliver it from a close range. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6bd74550189b5abd99a092162bc417899a5371a8.jpg

As mentioned above, we also have a new creature!  The Abomination is an abnormal freak of nature! As our latest high-level mob, the Abomination can be found somewhat infrequently stalking Ignus’ Plains and Tundra biomes. His immense size and duel-wielded axes make him a formidable opponent, capable of inflicting great damage very quickly. His major weakness is that he must get close, so try kiting him and using ranged weaponry. Engaging him in close combat will almost certainly be a fatal mistake.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/b49769c4d4fe99eca55094d2a4b24096c4ab9a03.jpg

The Abomination drops a set of new reagents: Sickly Hearts and Dark Plasma. While Sickly Hearts will be used in future crafting recipes, the energy of the Dark Plasma will now be a requirement in the crafting of Elixir of Demonic Spirit. It’s a good idea to hunt some of these guys down to maintain a healthy stock of reagents!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSygtTI3mmU
Here’s the full list of changes for this week’s patch:

 New Weapon: Blade of Simeon's Soul
New Creature: Abomination
New Reagents: Sickly Heart, Dark Plasma 
Various fixes to holes in the world’s terrain
Mature Langue Filter now defaults to on (can be turned off in Game Settings)
Fixed visual quirks with various armors 

As you may have read earlier this week, we’ve also gone ahead and closed a number of empty servers to better compress the community and make finding a populated server easier. If your preferred server was deleted we’ve archived and uploaded each world’s save data. Click here if you’d like to save this data and use it on your own private server/custom game!

Just as a quick note: We are aware that some players have encountered issues with FPS drops on some servers. We are investigating this issue and will update you all as soon as we have more information!

notes.title: Patch Preview - Abomination & Blade of Simeon's Soul
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7629e5bda185d0229349d23da166aa50d739c761.gif

Brace yourselves, denizens of Ignus! We’re getting to ready another content drop tomorrow, including a powerful new addition to the melee weapon tree and a horrific new nightmare beast, The Abomination. Take a look below for a little more info!


New Weapon: Blade of Simeon's Soul
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/6bd74550189b5abd99a092162bc417899a5371a8.jpg

An elegant longsword that has been enchanted with a piece of the legendary sorcerer Simeon's soul. In the right hands, the Blade of Simeon's Soul can be used to efficiently eviscerate Ignus' most intimidating adversaries.

The crafting of this powerful war blade requires a number of precious resources, including Iron and Gold Ingots, Irisite, and Dragon Stone. To unlock this legendary sword, players must reach level 50.


New Creature: Abomination
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/975a32f9ace05692ad1d501b5ba0b277ddd7a0bc.jpg

The wretched Abomination is the result of extensive dark magic experimentation conducted by the fanatical cultists of Ignus’ past. Centuries ago, these monstrosities roamed the plains and tundra freely during the peak of Ingus' dark era, but were eventually driven back and contained by the Priests of Neshan during their crusade against the dark arts.

The reemergence of these towering behemoths is quite ominous, and may signal the return of some ancient evil force. Could dark magic in Ignus be on the brink of resurgence? 


Developer Livestream
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/5c190e422d9de8725fc23842c5d2c8498b1cc43c.jpg

We’ll be going live tomorrow, September 13th at 4PM Eastern Time to answer some questions and show off the new content in this week’s patch! Come hang out and join the fun at twitch.tv/playcitadel

Server Maintenance
Notice: We'll be performing scheduled maintenance on our USEast servers and European servers on September 13th between 4am and 9am EST.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/8/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c7bfed84896f5667f13fc2f29e9520a58ff5c245.png

Hello, Wizards of Ignus! We’re putting out a quick hotfix today to supplement the patch we put out yesterday. As you may know from yesterday's patch notes, we had to hold back on two fixes. 

Wood and Stone Transmuters have had their productivity increased. Creating resources will now only require 25 mana, down from the previous requirement of 50. This should better enable players to generate larger quantities of building resources from their excess Rune Crystal.

We’re also throwing in a change to the game's decay system that wasn’t previously mentioned.  Now that we’ve significantly improved the way our servers handle the load of larger structures, we’re able to further decrease the decay rates for abandoned structures. Here’s what’s changed:

Abandoned wood pieces: Increased from 5 hours to 2 days
Abandoned stone pieces: Increased from 10 hours to 4 days
Abandoned ornate/marble pieces: Increased from 24 hours to 1 week

Lastly, we’ve unfortunately had to put another slight delay on the fix for disappearing tames. We’ve encountered some last minute issues with the fix during testing, and want to ensure that when we do put it out it’s ready and fully functional. We apologize for the second delay, and will have it ready for another hotfix next week.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/7/2017 - Marble Structure Set
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/08aa63344a7963ee38e1009d559db66d18e8b8f2.gif

It’s patch day, which means the Marble Structure Pack is finally here! This new addition adds a full set of entirely new structure pieces to Citadel, allowing you more creative flexibility in building elaborate and complex castles! This new high level set includes pristine marble walls, floors, roofs, windows, doors and much, much more. Get to level 45, unlock the new set, and begin crafting your masterpiece!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0aQ52DUxJ6o

The fantastic Marble Set isn’t the only noteworthy thing in this week’s patch. We’ve also made a bunch of tweaks and fixes to the game to improve the gameplay experience and eliminate exploits. Storage chests now lock properly depending on if you’re in a PVP or PVE server. You can now rebind the perspective toggle button. You can also no longer use mounts to clip into someone’s base while dismounting.

One small note for today’s patch: If you saw our Patch Preview yesterday, you saw we promised a fix for the disappearing tames and a rebalance of the Stone and Wood Transmuters. Due to some unfortunate last minute issues with the testing of these fixes, we will be slightly delaying their release. A hotfix will be deployed tomorrow morning to implement these fixes. Apologies for the slight delay!

In addition to the above, we’ve also made a ton of smaller quality of life changes. As always, the full details are listed below! See you in Ignus!

Structures
New Content: Marble Structure Pack
Storage Chests are now properly locked on PVE/unlocked on PVP

Tames & NPCs
After a number of failed attack attempts on a player NPCs will now flee
Fixed misconfiguration causing Divine Unicorns to spawn with extreme rarity
Fix to prevent players from dismounting through a wall/floor into someone's structure

World Fixes
 Fixed areas where players could drown while not in water
 Fixed multiple spots where players could get under the map
 Lava damage slightly increased
 Various world and spell sound tweaks

Other
 Perspective toggle added to keybind list
 Added Delete button to Create Game menu

notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/239183adee801dd6fe76c61d120f24850864a755.gif

Marble Build Contest
Coming tomorrow is the first major addition to our structure system: The Marble Structure Set!  To celebrate our first new major structure system content, we'll be hosting a Marble Castle building contest. We challenge you, once the update is out, to create the most impressive Marble structure you possibly can!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/08aa63344a7963ee38e1009d559db66d18e8b8f2.gif

To enter, submit your entries in the form of screenshots or video on Twitter, Facebook or in the new contest entry Steam sub-forum!. Contest period runs from Thursday, September 7th at 12pm EST to Friday, September 15th at 12pm EST.

Five winners will be selected by popular vote among Blue Isle Studios employees and will be announced during a livestream on Tuesday, September 19th at 4pm EST. Winners will receive:

First Prize (One Winner) – $100 Amazon Gift Card
Second Prize (One Winner) – $75 Amazon Gift Card
Third Prize (Three Winners) – $25 Amazon Gift Card

The Marble Set
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d709cd64866943d7e57e3f8beb2557557e9832b7.gif

This new high-level set of building pieces offers a clean, palatial alternative to the brooding, gothic aesthetic of the Ornate Set. 

The Marble Set is unlocked at level 45, just like the Ornate Set, and requires the use of repurposed Stone to be built. Some of the more lavish pieces, like doors and windows, may also require the use of Iron and Gold Ingots in their construction. 

This new set offers the complete range of building pieces including walls, floors, roofs, windows, doors, stairs and much more! Not only that, but you can mix and match the pieces with the other existing sets to create appealing combinations. The Marble Set mixed with the Ornate Set, for example, provides a stunning contrast of a flat, clean white accented by shining metallic gold.

Disappearing Tames Fix
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/85b5150512663681125f4e255cc217d1a0b652cc.jpg

Many players have reported returning after updating their client to find that their precious dragons, unicorns and demons were no longer waiting for them. With tomorrow's patch, this should no longer be the case. Tamed creatures will now properly position themselves where you left them once the server went down so you can safely return to exploring and adventuring with them.

UPDATE: Due to some last minute issues with the testing of this fix, we will be saving it for a hotfix to shortly follow tomorrow morning's patch. Apologies for the minor delay!

Much More
As always, there will be a few smaller tweaks and fixes in tomorrow's patch. Players can now delete their created world from within the Create Game menu, NPCs have been given a tweak to give up their chase if they fail to hit you with a certain number of attacks, and we've fixed an exploit that allowed players to dismount a tame through a base's wall. Stay tuned for full patch notes tomorrow!

notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/31a5b90655204c2ecad93b0910464205f8db1eb9.png

Structure-Related Server Fixes
To further improve the performance of our servers we’re putting out another quick patch. This fix should significantly improve server performance for servers that have struggled under the strain of multiple extreme and complex structures. We’ve implemented a change to how our server loads in and manages their pieces, which should help reduce the frequency of server crashes and outages.

Steam Trading Cards
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/fa752788ae22a968a4ef549c7af289402b228635.jpg

Additionally, we’ve also added trading cards to the game! Now as you play Citadel you'll earn trading cards which can be used to unlock unique Citadel badges as well as some spiffy Steam emoticons and backgrounds!

As always, please make sure to update your game client and give the official servers a chance to update. Enjoy the server optimizations and cards, and we'll see you in Ignus soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/30/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/61481d726cdd824c73925614da0dca33030cd821.jpg

It’s patch day! We’re putting out another big patch today with two brand new pieces of content: The majestic Divine Unicorn and the battle-ready Tempered Iron Armor. Additionally, we’ve made a number of important bug fixes, gameplay tweaks and performance optimizations.

We’ve put together another fix for out servers that should hopefully bring some of our non-functional worlds back online. The issue is related to the extreme structure load some servers possess, and we’re working to keep up with the increasing strain. That said, this fix should do a lot of good to fix this problem, and we should have another pretty significant fix ready to address this issue later this week.

We’ve also fixed up a bug that caused the Deconstructor to destroy the incorrect items by mistake, which caused frustration for a number of players in the community. Now, any item you drop into the Deconstructor will be the item it disassembles for resources.

We’ve also made a variety of smaller fixes. UI improvements and fixes for 4:3 resolution monitors, new measures to prevent the construction of thrones and other magic structures under water, destroyed storage chests will now drop their loot in loot bags, and much more! As always, take a look below for the full notes, and we hope to see you in Ignus again soon!
 
New Content
New Creature: Divine Unicorn
New Armor: Tempered Iron Armor

Structures
Heal Beam once again works properly on structure pieces
Deconstructor will now correctly destroy the intended items
Destroyed storage chests now drop loot bags
Can no longer build magic structures underwater
IAdjusted Transmuter/Rune Recycler mana usage and output to prevent an extreme resource generation exploit
Increased damage on attack tower magic structures

User Interface
Further fixes for menus on 4:3 displays
New World Create screen
Server Name now appears in-game
Mount button removed for unmountable creatures

Other Optimizations, Tweaks & Fixes
Server structure improvements to bring non-functional servers back up
Reduced concentration of rare enemies in some areas
Fixed Elixir of Amnesia not removing equipped spells
Patched up spots that allowed building under the terrain

notes.title: Patch Preview - Divine Unicorn, Tempered Iron Armor & Marble Set Livestream
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/85b5150512663681125f4e255cc217d1a0b652cc.jpg

Greetings, Wizards! Thanks to your fantastic support and feedback we have another big update coming tomorrow with some new content, gameplay balance tweaks, and bunch of  important bug fixes. Take a look below for details on what you can expect tomorrow!

Divine Unicorn
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3b4a73fd9243d269364b9fd3c2c0375a9d6171a8.jpg

Long thought to be driven to extinction by the twisted dark magic that birthed its corrupted brethren, the Divine Unicorn has reemerged across Ignus. While the common Unicorns embody dark energy and corrupt magic, the Divine Unicorn is pure, and radiates with divine light. 

Like its counterparts, the Divine Unicorn is extremely uncommon. Its blood – which can be used to concot powerful potions and is used in imbuing high level magic weaponry – makes it a particularly appealing target for hunters. If you should see one, attack before it flees!

Tempered Iron Armor
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/73a17551beefb215a081e208c66c4e503254ab27.jpg

The Tempered Iron Armor set is the next set in the Iron path of armors. Like the lower tier Iron Armor, the Tempered set is covered in dense, heavy metal plating from top to bottom, providing the wearer with a superior defense. This set possesses a high base defense stat, and will endure a heavy beating with minimal wear and tear!

No armor is perfect, and the Tempered set is no exception; this set does have a few flaws. For one, it requires a significant amount of resources to craft, which can make acquiring a full set quite the undertaking. Additionally, because of its thick, heavy nature, this set can be quite a burden. You’ll want to make sure you’ve spent plenty of Character Points on Carrying Capacity if you’ll want to wear this set with room to spare for potions, trinkets and loot!

Various Fixes and Tweaks
As always, we'll be making many smaller fixes and tweaks to improve the game experience. Some noteworthy fixes:
Servers will again be given more optimization to ensure they stay up longer and can better manage the load of extreme structures. 
The heal beam will once again work as intended to repair damage structure pieces. 
The Deconstructor will now destroy the correct items.
 Increased damage for defensive towers

And much more! Stay tuned for the full details tomorrow!

Marble Set Livestream
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f454e7279962d3599f223e60679b873d84a04d04.jpg

Our Marble Set is still a few weeks away, but you can join us for a sneak peek tomorrow at 4PM Eastern Time to see a live build of a full Marble Castle! We'll take your suggestions for where we should build it and what it should look like, as well as answering your Marble related questions, so come hang out in chat and share your thoughts, feedback and queries! twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/23/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ccbeac221cf810cbd077a85c31cac3a5e6ce2acc.gif

We’re ready to deploy this week’s Wednesday update! This week will be mostly focused on some rebalancing of our Siege Spells based on your feedback since their implementation last week. We’ve made them easier to get at earlier levels, and have made the Divine Bomb a little less abusable by making its recipe harder and reducing the size of its AOE. You can read more about those changes in yesterday’s Patch Preview..

We’ve also made a number of smaller quality-of-life changes. No-build zones have been added above Fast Travel towers to prevent players from completely sealing them, we’ve implemented a fix to ensure that Mana Generator energy does not clear out when a server restarts, and we’ve added some additional little love to the server browser.

As you may have noticed, this week’s patch contains no new content, as everything we’re currently working on needs a little more time in the oven. We're still hard at work on new creatures, weapons, armors, spells and gameplay features for the game, and will be back to adding new goodies next week. Stay tuned for details soon!

Here’s the complete changelist for today’s patch:
Divine bomb AOE radius decreased
Elixir of Divine Being recipe now requires 6 Phoenix Feathers
Arcane Bomb moved to level 15
Divine Bomb moved to level 30
Celestial Bomb moved to level 45
Added a no-build zone above fast-travel towers
Increased Reformation Stone Healing
Fixed Divine Orb damage output
Server browser now shows which servers you have a character saved on
Mana Generators now properly persist Rune Crystals on server restarts
Can no longer crouch while jumping
Fiery Essence’s weight has been changed to match other essences

Developer Livestream
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3987f293cde364c81a37cc69824701315026d2df.jpg
Come join us on Twitch today at 4PM Eastern Time as we go live to play some Citadel and answer your questions! Follow us at www.twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Patch Preview - Siege Spell Rebalances
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/98e01c864b148bab5b633f82bbc9303406e58a46.jpg

Good afternoon, fellow Wizards! As always, we’ll be putting out our weekly patch tomorrow with the usual selection of bug fixes and balance tweaks. Today’s patch preview will be a little more focused as we talk about incoming changes to the recently implemented Siege Spells.

Siege Spell Rebalances
We’ve been observing the reactions to our new Siege Spells closely, and have absorbed a great deal of feedback from the community. While a lot of the feedback has been positive, many people have pointed out places where the current balance may need some readjustment. This week we’ll be making our first balance changes to further improve the dynamic:

Siege Spell Unlock Adjustment
One of the first thing’s we’ll be tweaking is the current level at which players can access their first Siege Spell. Many pointed out that level 35 is a bit extreme, and may not give lower level players the ability to retaliate should they find themselves the target of a raid. To remedy this, we’ve shifted the levels a bit:
Arcane Bomb will now be unlocked at level 15
Divine Bomb will now be unlocked at level 30
Celestial Bomb will now be unlocked at level 45

Divine Bomb Nerf
Additionally, Divine Bomb will be receiving a bit of a nerf. We’ve seen a lot of feedback suggesting that this spell is both too strong, and too easy to acquire. To combat this, we’ve made its AOE range significantly smaller to prevent it from causing massive damage to large chunks of a structure. Additionally, we’re increasing the number of Phoenix Feathers require to craft it from 4 to 6. 

More Fixes and Balance Changes
We'll detail the various fixes and balance changes tomorrow in our full patch notes, so stay tuned and check back tomorrow!

Developer Livestream
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3987f293cde364c81a37cc69824701315026d2df.jpg

Lastly, be sure to come hang out with us this Wednesday while we play some Citadel and answer your questions! We'll run down the new content we've recently added, talk about some things we have in the works, and answer chat questions.

Follow us at http://twitch.tv/playcitadel

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8/16/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/18e98c3a1e1d24f53bc0effe04a40d49e18c8f2f.gif

Today is Wednesday, and Wednesday means patch day! The team has been hard at work on today’s update, which includes some pretty significant new systems and content. Yesterday we wrote about Siege Spells, Corpse Markers, New UI Improvements and the brand-new Phoenix enemy. You can click here to check that out now!

The complexity and size of the buildings that you guys have constructed has been far beyond anything we imagined! Because of the immensity of these structures, we’ve been able to identify an engine-level issue with how physics objects are handled by PhysX. This issue has contributed to the lack of stability that has burdened some servers, particularly our European servers. We’ve implemented a fix that should alleviate some of these issues and keep our Euro servers up longer! Server stability is, as it always will be, an on-going priority for us, so please let us know if your server of choice continues to struggle after today’s update.

Additionally, magical properties will now generate correctly on crafted items, weapons and armors. We found that our Magic Find system was not configured properly, causing these enchantments to appear significantly less frequently than we intended. This should now be fixed!

Lastly, we’ve fixed the way the Elixir of Amnesia works on private servers with XP multipliers. The Elixir works by reducing your level to 0 and then immediately giving you the XP you need to return to your previous level. This process is now immune to XP multiplication.


Here’s the complete changelist for today’s patch:

New Content
New creature: Phoenix
New reagent: Phoenix Feathers
Siege spells added: Celestial Bomb, Arcane Bomb, Divine Bomb

Structures
Structures are now only vulnerable to Siege spells

User Interface
Improved tame menu
Improved death screen
Improved build menu
Corpse markers added to map on death
Corpse markers turn grey if player's loot bag despawns or is taken

Crafting
Crafted items will now have a chance of having multiple magic properties
Elixir of Amnesia now works properly on servers with XP multipliers

Other
Server optimizations
Player dropped loot bags now stick around for 15 minutes

Please be sure to update your client via Steam, and give our servers a moment to come back online with the latest version of Citadel. As always, we hope to see you in Ignus!

notes.title: Patch Preview - Phoenix, Siege Spells, Corpse Marker & More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/e399918a23ec8f3dda6cdc7ac3baca1398035346.jpg

Greetings, Wizards! Thanks to your fantastic support and feedback we have another big update for tomorrow featuring hotly requested gameplay changes, balance adjustments and even a new creature! Raiding is being improved, things like corpse markers have been added to make your life a little easier, and the game’s UI is getting another dose of polish. As always, please continue to share your feedback with us here on Steam, on Twitter and through our support email!

Here’s what’s coming tomorrow:

Phoenix
We’re adding another new creature to Ignus’ bestiary: the legendary Phoenix. A mythical creature born of flame and ancient magic, the fiery Phoenix is an extremely rare specimen. Reported sightings are few and far between, with no consistent time or location amongst them to help narrow the search.

Hunting the Phoenix will take patience and determination, but the rewards are worth it. Not only do they drop quality loot, but their feathers are necessary in the crafting of powerful siege magic elixirs.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/05a1b6967649f4172c2cf3d2395b98f7b34e4eb6.gif


Siege Spells
Our existing raiding dynamic needed some work. The way our RPG character progression worked in parallel to a system of structure sieging was not working in a way we’d hoped. It encouraged the griefing of defenseless low-level players rather than fostering meaningful raiding between powerful players. 

To improve this, we’ll be introducing a series of spells specifically intended for raiding. These will be the only spells capable of destroying structure pieces, and will only be used by crafting extremely expensive consumable elixirs. By doing this, raiders will now be encouraged to target players they actually stand to gain something from, rather than targeting low level players who are just starting to learn the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f4d6c9d15e71fdfe85a6d5e30651db82c6474e3d.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/47abd4aa565de2e7574a61303490355fc054bcf8.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/7bbd90b0757f304d16b023f4452641da897779a5.jpg


Corpse Marker
Tired of stumbling through the Tundra, aimlessly looking for your dropped loot after you’ve died? Us too! That’s why we’ve taken your feedback to heart and updated our existing map system to support a corpse marker. Now, when you die, a marker will be left on the map to track where it happened. This marker will even change color if your loot is picked up or despawns, so you’ll know when it’s worth your effort to make the trek.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/099b1ed478d56baf8105077f199191418ff876ec.jpg


New Tame UI
Hot on the heels of our HUD update, we’ve added some more polish to the overall presentation of our in-game UI. The tame menu, for example, has been given a bunch of love. In addition to just looking much slicker, it also resolves the pesky issue of having the button to mount a creature right beside the button to free them. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/c6e09839c574a07cee2757cc411c6b47d5dfcaf7.png


New Build UI
We’re also giving our building menu some love to bring it up to the standard set by our previous UI changes. We’ve shifted everything over to the side to give you a clearer view of your health and mana while you’re building, and have made it easier to see the resource costs associated with each building piece.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/469f38233bc7dd7f17b3643bd79cd48e15ba26a2.png


New Death Screen
Lastly, we’ve updated the death screen. Functionally it’s pretty much the same but, man, does it ever look way cooler! Take a look for yourself!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d3122d05946bf2251d756ff2f2974c926fbab64d.gif


Much More
As always, we have a ton more tweaks, fixes and improvements coming with tomorrow’s patch. For the full details, check out complete patch notes here on Steam tomorrow. Thanks again for your support and feedback, and we hope to see you in Ignus!

Patch Notes
We’re pushing out one last small patch this week ahead of the weekend. This patch will hopefully put an end to an issue we’ve been working hard on fixing for a while now: non-responsive AI.

As some of you may have encountered, there have been circumstances where AI will not respond to player presence or attacks. Try as you might to change their behavior, enemies would continue walking on their merry way. This should no longer be the case after this update.

Once you’ve updated your clients, and the servers have returned, this should hopefully be resolved. Private server owners should also make sure their server is updated to get the fix on their custom games.


New Ornamental Structure Pieces, UI Improvements and Bug Fixes
We deployed another big patch on Wednesday to add a series of ornamental structure piece options to the game, including paintings, rugs, lighting options and statues. We’ve even added bookshelves and door-variant bookshelves so you can add secret rooms to your castles!

We also updated our server browser functionality, made our in-game HUD a little cleaner, pumped out some new crash fixes, and increased our structure decay times! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/9a9678cba2be1b44c838c6b5ee68cfe0270a85ba.gif

Click here to read all the details of our Wednesday patch!


Coming Next Week

Take a look at the image above for a sneak peek, and stay tuned for new details next week!

notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/80016e6a9e3476d419443926f46d26d8e677236e.jpg

It’s Wednesday, which means we have another patch ready to go! Today’s patch will address a number of lingering issues while at the same time adding a selection of new decorative structure options. For more info on these new building options check out our patch preview post.

As mentioned in our patch preview, we’ve made significant improvements to our server browser. Servers can now be filtered and sorted in a variety of ways, making it easier for you to the exact game that meets your needs. Want to only see official European servers, and have them ordered by player count? Trying to find the lowest possible ping? The server browser update has you covered.

We’ve also made significant improvements to the in-game UI to reduce screen clutter and make things a little cleaner. Health and Mana bars, for example, have been moved below your hotkeys to keep all essential information centered in one convenient area.

We’ve also heard plenty of commentary about our current decay model for throned structures. Before this patch, a throne would completely decay after 10 days if not properly maintained. In response to the community’s feedback, we’re bumping that up to 16 days. This will help make maintaining your structure a bit less of a chore.

As always, this update includes a bunch of crash fixes, including a frequently reported crash that occurs when equipping various armors, especially the new Iron set. Take a look at the complete list of changes below!

(NOTE: Our USWest servers will be down on August 10th between 3am and 5am pst for hardware upgrades)

Throne decay time increased from 10 days to 16 days
Rugs added

Lighting options added
Statues added
Bookshelves added

User Interface

Sort by name added to server browser
Sort by PVP/PVE added to server browser
Sort by number of players added to server browser
Sort by region added to server browser
Sort by ping added to server browser
Filter full/empty servers added to server browser
Filter official/custom servers added to server browser

Other

notes.title: Hotfix - 8/3/2017 - Crash on Load
notes.notes:
We have reproduced and fixed a major issue which would cause some players, many of whom were using AMD hardware, to crash while trying to load into the game (usually at about 95% loaded). This issue was identified and reproduced on our AMD machine, but was likely also affecting some players with NVIDIA hardware too.

We've managed to reliably stop this from reproducing on our end and wanted to get the patch out to everyone ASAP. Please let us know if you continue to have issues and share with us your crash logs so we can diagnose and fix the problem.

Be sure to let your client update and give the official servers a moment to come back online with the latest build.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope to see you in-game!

notes.title: Patch Preview - New Content, Optimizations, Telekinesis Changes & More
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/81cd8849e0be01194fecb543cf3d85039ccb59ef.gif

Greetings, Wizards! We'll be releasing a large update tomorrow to inject some new creatures into the game while also improving stability and addressing some gameplay and balance issues. Your support and feedback has played a direct role in helping to identify bugs and balance issues, and we want to thank you greatly for sharing your feedback with us here on Steam, on Twitter and through our support email!

(Scroll down to read about bug fixes and balance changes)

New Game Content

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/04fb664504da3eef9712e4c6b243a7e5a134d1f9.jpg
Infernal Dragon
The Infernal Dragon is a towering nightmare of jagged fangs, spiraling horns and dense, rippling muscle. Most scholars agree that the Infernal Dragon was once similar in size and appearance to the common dragons of Ignus, but after longterm exposure to demonic energy it has become a twisted abomination that exists only to terrorize those who would venture too far into the untamed Tundra of the north.

Approach the Infernal Dragon with extreme caution. If you are compelled to engage in combat with this formidable adversary be sure to bring allies and a healthy supply of rejuvenate provisions.  It will be a long, hard fight, but in the end you will be rewarded handsomely with significant experience and a bounty of rare and valuable crafting resources.

Some say it’s possible to tame and ride such creatures, but most regard this is as wild speculation by mad men and fools…


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/114766d7a08cf33134a5d9c990456378d1b47e7b.png
Skeleton Warriors
The same evil magic that delivered the scourge of Imps and Demons unto this world has been used to reanimate the ancient dead of Ignus’ ancient warring houses. These Skeleton Warriors, who have risen from millennia of slumber, are fast and swift attackers who aim to catch their opponents off guard and attack by clawing and biting. Skeletons tend to coalesce in groups, and can easily surround you if you let them get too close. Fighting from a distance is recommended.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/ca206324ad686b421c7347e052dbad235f0ed1cc.png
Wild Boar
Though it may appear to be nothing more than a simple beast of burden, the Wild Boar is actually quite dangerous when encountered in its natural habitat. They are aggressive, impulsive beasts that have often been observed lashing out at perceived threats. A minor threat for seasoned mages, but newly minted wizards should be wary in their presence.


Fixes, Optimizations and Balance Changes

Optimizations
We’ve made an important change in the backend of the game that should make performance and stability on populated servers up to ten times better. The source of a lot of our server issues stems from a bug in the Unreal Engine itself: while UE’s distance culling system does not draw objects within a certain distance of the player, it was still sorting the priority of tens of thousands of undrawn objects every single frame. 

We’ve created our own custom distance culler to combat this, which will exclude objects at an extreme distance from the prioritization process.  This should greatly improve performance and reduce structure download times. 

Telekinesis
After listening to your feedback and commentary it has become obvious to us that our current implementation of Telekinesis needed a little rethinking. We wanted to ensure it would not become a tool for griefing, but clearly that did not end up being the case. To those that lost their hard work to the spell, we do sincerely apologize.

We didn’t want to just turn off structure Telekinesis, so we came up with the following solution: along with now never working on PVE structures (as it should never have), Telekinesis will no longer be usable on any structure that has been claimed by a throne. If you want to throw structure pieces now it can only happen with structures that have been rendered abandoned. This means that another player can no longer use the spell to casually dismantle your fortress. As with all balance changes, we will be monitoring this closely to see how it plays with the current layout of the game.

Spell Improvements
We’ve tidied up a number of issues related to spell cooldowns, key among them being the weapon swapping exploit. After tomorrow’s patch you will no longer be able to rapdily swap weapons with ‘G’ to cancel cooldowns and spam high level, high cooldown spells. Some players took advantage of this bug to gain a significant advantage in PVP fights, and we wanted to ensure it was patched up to prevent griefing.

Additionally, we’ve added ranges to many of the game’s spells. Spells like Fireball previously had unlimited range which was problematic from the perspective of both PVP balance and server performance. Enemies could spam Fireballs from miles away and it would be impossible for the recipient to retaliate, and Fireballs shot into the air would continue to exist and travel indefinitely, straining the server after long periods of time. These two issues should now no longer exist with Wednesday’s patch.

Decay Modifiers for Private Servers
Your server, your rules. We implemented the new decay system to reduce strain on our official servers, but we want to ensure that private server owners have the flexibility to opt out. After Wednesday’s update you will have the ability to either decrease/increase the decay rate or turn it off altogether. 

Much More
There will be a ton of other tweaks, fixes and improvements in the patch: Camera sensitivity options, pet inventory fixes and much more.  Stay tuned for the details and full changelog tomorrow. We greatly appreciate your patience as we patch up the game and make it a more stable and balanced experience!


Update Livestream

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/3753924e6343aeba616e63b04272c332c6894a1c.png

We're doing it live! Join us tomorrow at 4pm EDT to see us walkthrough the new content and fixes, and listen to us talk about the future of Citadel. Hop over to twitch.tv/playcitadel and give us a follow to make sure you don't miss out!

- Blue Isle Studios

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/30/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/d1cd7a56a5ad50d11cc995436eaa809df4079e3e.jpg

Good afternoon! We’re deploying another patch today to apply a small change to our structure degradation system. Lag and connectivity issues increase as junk structures gather on a server; to prevent this, we’re putting a system in place to remove abandoned thrones and clean up old structures with no ownership attached to them. This change will work as a means of improving longterm server performance and stability.

The following will take effect after the game and our servers have been updated:

- Thrones will decay in 10 days unless you replace them or heal them
- If abandoned (dethroned), wood pieces will decay in roughly 5 hours
- If abandoned (dethroned), stone pieces will decay in roughly 10 hours
- If abandoned (dethroned), ornate pieces will decay in roughly 24 hours
- If abandoned (dethroned), magic and decorative structures will decay in roughly 5 hours

We’ve also made a few behind the scenes changes to help people attempting to join populated official servers. Please ensure your client is up-to-date, and allow time for the update to roll out to servers.

We apologize for the gameplay disruption, and appreciate your support as we work to improve stability and performance.

-	Blue Isle Studios

notes.title: Content Update & Patch Notes - 7/28/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/bceb2233264a5b1e77d6cdb2e7d46ea24bd7aaa4.gif

It’s full steam ahead for us here at Blue Isle Studios! We’ve been absolutely blown away by the warm reception we’ve received since our Early Access launch two days ago, and have been working tirelessly to crush bugs, tweak gameplay balance and prepare new and awesome content for you guys to enjoy.

(Scroll down for full patch notes including bug and exploit fixes. Give a moment once the patch has been rolled out via Steam for the servers to update to the new version.)

Content Drop: Iron Armor & Bear Claw Gauntlet
We’re ready to put out our first content update, which adds five new crafting recipes for the early levels of the game. Since we know most of you are still finding your footing in Ignus, we figured you’d appreciate a few more early-game options to add a little variety to your experience. Here’s what we’ve got for you:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1fd65b9681b146673f2cf743c65481f7450208f5.jpg

First up is the newest addition to our lineup of armor types: Iron Armor. Once you’ve unlocked the Iron set in the Knowledge Tree you’ll be able to repurpose the natural iron deposits of Ignus into an extremely robust protective garb. Just don’t skimp on the Carrying Capacity! The dense, metal plating that covers this substantial set of armor is extremely heavy, and can be cumbersome for mages who aren’t ready for the additional burden. 

This set is perfect for players adopting a close-range tank-style playstyle, but less ideal for mages interested in long-range, nimble combat. Despite being a low-tier set, the iron armor is pretty demanding from a crafting perspective. You’ll have to gather a heck of a lot of Iron Ingots, Rune Crystal, Leather and Cloth if you’ll want the whole set.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f880c3f72a23bc0d971d8b27cad63097e542bbd7.jpg

For those interested in a more barbaric vibe, we’ve also added the brand new Bear Claw Gauntlet. Hunt and kill the savage Bears of Ignus and use their Pelts and Bones to create this intimidating new weapon. Though it may look primitive, the Bear Claw Gauntlet is a great early-game choice for casting the devastating damage-over-time spells the gauntlet sub-category is known for.

Patch Notes
We’ve also made a bunch of changes, including bug and exploit fixes and balance adjustments.

The biggest change you’ll notice is that we’ve buffed structures by a lot. We’ve been hearing your feedback that the current means of raiding is just too aggressive. We’re implementing this buff as a temporary measure to mitigate the potential for griefing while we work on a more elegant solution in the future. (Note: Existing structures will unfortunately not have their HP update, but new ones will have the effect applied. We’ll deploy a free refill on all structure HP with our next patch).

We’ve also cleaned up a few key exploits. Swapping potions no longer gives you their effect for free, and we’ve also made it so that you can’t kill a high level friend at a low level to get insane amounts of XP. Additionally, we've removed an exploit that allowed some players to have zero HP and become unkillable.

It’s full steam ahead for us here at Blue Isle Studios! We’ve been absolutely blown away by the warm reception we’ve received since our Early Access launch two days ago, and have been working tirelessly to crush bugs, tweak gameplay balance and prepare new and awesome content for you guys to enjoy.

(Scroll down for full patch notes including bug and exploit fixes. Give a moment once the patch has been rolled out via Steam for the servers to update to the new version.)

Content Drop: Iron Armor & Bear Claw Gauntlet
We’re ready to put out our first content update, which adds five new crafting recipes for the early levels of the game. Since we know most of you are still finding your footing in Ignus, we figured you’d appreciate a few more early-game options to add a little variety to your experience. Here’s what we’ve got for you:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/1fd65b9681b146673f2cf743c65481f7450208f5.jpg

First up is the newest addition to our lineup of armor types: Iron Armor. Once you’ve unlocked the Iron set in the Knowledge Tree you’ll be able to repurpose the natural iron deposits of Ignus into an extremely robust protective garb. Just don’t skimp on the Carrying Capacity! The dense, metal plating that covers this substantial set of armor is extremely heavy, and can be cumbersome for mages who aren’t ready for the additional burden. 

This set is perfect for players adopting a close-range tank-style playstyle, but less ideal for mages interested in long-range, nimble combat. Despite being a low-tier set, the iron armor is pretty demanding from a crafting perspective. You’ll have to gather a heck of a lot of Iron Ingots, Rune Crystal, Leather and Cloth if you’ll want the whole set.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f880c3f72a23bc0d971d8b27cad63097e542bbd7.jpg

Hunt and kill the savage Bears of Ignus and use their Pelts and Bones to create this intimidating new weapon. Though it may look primitive, the Bear Claw Gauntlet is a great early-game choice for casting the devastating damage-over-time spells the gauntlet sub-category is known for.

We’ve also made a bunch of changes, including bug and exploit fixes and balance adjustments.

The biggest change you’ll notice is that we’ve buffed structures by a lot. We’ve been hearing your feedback that the current means of raiding is just too aggressive. We’re implementing this buff as a temporary measure to mitigate the potential for griefing while we work on a more elegant solution in the future. (Note: Existing structures will unfortunately not have their HP update, but new ones will have the effect applied. We’ll deploy a free refill on all structure HP with our next patch).

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/25/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/f307a3d3683251a44251d6fe3a66b4dc58d3cf39.jpg

This is it! Tomorrow’s the big day! Citadel: Forged with Fire will be available for purchase on July 26th!

In addition to preparing a slew of fresh new servers to ensure we are prepared to meet launch demand, we’ve made some final little tweaks to the game’s balance to remove some critical exploits and solve some major bugs.

One of our biggest findings from the playtest was that structures were just too easy to raid. Walls could be smashed down with minimal effort, which cause some players a great deal of frustration. We’ve implemented changes to correct this problem.

We also received a lot of feedback suggesting that XP gained from spam building certain structure pieces was highly exploitable. It’s not ideal for anyone to have spam building of junk structures be an encouraged activity, so we’ve rebalanced a few things to make this a much less effective method of leveling.

Lastly, we made the choice, based on your feedback, to pull chest icons off the map entirely. You made it clear that finding these chests didn’t feel special, and we agree. Now you will be encouraged to explore the world to find these chests on your own, which should overall make the game feel more rewarding.

We’ve also made a few other key bug fixes and tweaks, so take a look at the expanded notes below. We hope to see you in-game very soon!

NPCs and Tames
-	Dragons have had their damage and mana regen nerfed to ensure they are less OP in PVP
-	Tames no longer attack housemates, and can be safely parked at a shared House castle

Houses
-	Respawn Stones now show up for players in the same House

Building
-	Structure pieces have had their health tripled
-	Thrones have been given an even greater buff (2.5k health -> 10k health)
-	XP gained from construction has been reduced
-	Single Scaffolding Piece: XP gain has been decreased and cost has been increased to prevent abuse
-	Fixed a bug that caused players to lose control of their home when moving their throne

 Other
-	Chest icons have been removed from the map
-	Significant VOIP improvements
-	Display will now scale properly in 4:3 resolutions
-	Arrow keys can now be used for movement
-	FOV and other options can no longer be set ridiculously high or low by typing in the text field
-	Windows PC names no longer appear in House menu before a player creates a character
-	Server populations will display properly in the server browser
-	Server and performance optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/19/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29650925/cb1940c00be6127304d44216b156649c7e5e3f7f.gif

Welcome to our very first Citadel: Forged with Fire patch notes post! We had an absolute blast watching all the streams and gameplay videos that came out during our first Closed Beta Test, and used all the feedback we observed to tweak the game’s balance and improve the gameplay experience for our next test. 

We noticed most players encountered issues with our NPC behavior. Enemies would give chase to players infinitely, and the only option to deal with them was to jump in a pool of water and snipe them from safety. To fix this, we’ve made a number of changes to our NPC AI, which should hopefully resolve this issue.

Spell balance was another thing we decided to take a look at coming out of last weekend. Players expected spells to be more powerful, so we went ahead and gave them some significant buffs. Additionally, we also addressed some audio and graphical issues that may have occurred (I’m looking at you Haste).

In addition to the above, we made some key changes to building and map presentation, and added a few small things here and there to make some confusing things a little more obvious. Oh, and we added VOIP!

Transparency and communication is a top priority for us as we move towards and beyond our Early Access launch, and we can’t wait to continue rapidly delivering new content, balance changes and bug fixes on a constant basis.

Take a look below, and we hope to see you in-game soon!



NPCs
-	NPCs will now drop aggro when you run away. No more being chased from the Whispering Woods all the way up to Venturer’s Bane by 50 Orcs! 
-	NPC movement has been increased. You can run, and they’ll eventually lose interest, but don’t expect to be faster than a wolf while running backward now.
-	NPC perception has been decreased. Orcs will no longer spot you from a mile away, so you will now be able to better avoid unwanted encounters.
-	Forest Guardian rock  throws should now work properly instead of harmlessly exploding near you.
-	NPC health has been balanced. We’ve made it so early game enemies (near starter towns) are a little easier and late game enemies (up north in the Tundra regions) are less abusable.

Structures
-	Doors and door frames have been renamed to avoid confusion. You do not have to build a door frame to build a door. They are two independent building options.
-	Doors should no longer render off the hinges and should be placed properly within the wall. As you’d expect from a door.
-	All references to “Nexus” replaced with “Throne” for clarity.
-	Some adjustments to build menu icons to make things a little easier to understand.

 Spells/Combat
-	Lots of spell buffs. Players last weekend observed that spells were not doing as much damage as basic melee, which felt a little off. Damage, cooldowns and mana costs have all been adjusted to give them a little more oomf.
-	You can no longer fire spells off while swimming. Now water will be useful in escaping mobs, but cannot be used to cheese enemies. 
-	Telekinesis is now very expensive and a lot weaker. We want this spell to be underpowered at launch, and we’ll slowly readjust and increase its power as we go. We don’t want this spell to become too overpowered and have it ruin anyone’s experience.
-	Pacify has been rebalanced. You can now only tame creatures ten levels higher than you or less.
-	Extract costs less mana to cast to make resource gathering less tedious.

Other
-	VOIP is now live! Push “-“ in-game and start getting chatty!
-	Mana and health pools regenerate your vitals a lot slower to avoid abuse. Our plan for mana and health pools was to have them as a places where you can rest for a moment and top up your vitals. This is more in-line with that objective.
-	Saddles are now craftable to allow creature riding.
-	The House window will now display properly for all players.
-	Empty chests now properly show as opened.
-	Haste, Bloodlust and Blue Aura VFX now stop when the buff wears off.
-	Resource rich rocks are now glowier and more noticeable.
-	Lots of map presentation tweaks.

notes.title: Sign-up for the Pre-Release Beta Test!
notes.notes:

Are you of the opinion that waiting is for chumps? So are we! 

To ensure our July 26th Early Access launch is butter smooth, we’ll be letting waves of players into the game early. Simply head to the official Citadel website, fill out the Beta Test application form, and cross your fingers!
